additional_mass.legacy_partition_selector_policy: InteriorPartition is a retained material selector. Instantiate additional mass from this inventory only; never instantiate both representations of the same source object.

mass_accounting.floor_pair_policy: one physical slab; do not add both floor and ceiling capacity

paired_surface_policy.adjacent_ceiling: reverse the same canonical floor assembly

reference-mass-recipe-e7519864ff3887e0a7.interpretation: Original source mass material layers; no equivalent fitting or added air films.

reference.quantity_basis: multiply normalized quantities by actual counted building floor area

reference_area_approximation.interpretation: Interior wall faces between zones are halved and floors counted once, each with its zone multiplier; the IDF faces carry no pairing information.

mass_accounting.removed_wall_policy: Restore only unrepresented InteriorWall capacity using source or equivalent recipes; exchange equivalence remains approximate
mass_accounting.residual_floor_policy: Restore only unrepresented InteriorFloor capacity; explicit slabs retain their capacity
mass_accounting.residual_policy: max(0, reference minus represented); report signed difference and excess; never subtract mass

provenance.interpretation_note: Additive approximation, not replacement detailed rules. Reported fit errors are not building energy error bounds (ADR 0045).
provenance.original_unit: source SI layers and IDF net surface areas
provenance.transformation: source assignments, net IDF surface areas as weights, fixed two-parameter thermal approximation (scripts.construction_equivalence); design-flow infiltration unchanged

excluded_ground_constructions.interpretation: F- or C-factor constructions have no layers. The adiabatic F-factor slabs with no exposed perimeter are ground floors (ADR 0046 section 11) and are left out of the floor mass (ADR 0045).
